name: American Salars Lithium Inc.
summary: American Salars Lithium Inc. focuses its operations on acquiring and evaluating mineral deposits. Its most significant asset is the fully-owned Pocitos 1 Lithium Salar Project, an extensive 13,880-hectare site located in Salta, Argentina. Established in 2019 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, the company was previously known as Blanton Resources Corp. before it rebranded to American Salars Lithium Inc. in December 2023.
